Last Thursday morning, as the government shutdown began it's second day, House Speaker Mike Johnson was holding a news conference and speaking on various aspects of the issue.
But a funny thing happened to Speaker Johnson, and to those watching him on both CNN and MSNBC.
He was interrupted, taken away, replaced by, and then "corrected" by the anchors in place at each respective network.
To prevent the distribution of "misinformation" by Johnson!
Both MSNBC's Anna Cabrera and CNN's Pamela Brown cut away for the same reason, just about a minute or so apart.
This is so outrageous but certainly not unfamiliar.
How many times have these two networks either cut away from a Donald Trump speech or Q & A session?
How many times have they not broadcast any of it at all?

When have we ever seen CNN or MSNBC cut out of a Joe Biden, or Kamala Harris or Chuck Schumer presser, or cut away from Hakeem Jeffries, or any Democrat, to "prevent misinformation" from being dispersed?
When have we seen CNN or MSNBC anchors say, "that's just not true", following a claim from a Democrat?
It certainly looks like the instructions were out.
For CNN and MSNBC to cut away from Mike Johnson while he was discussing one particular topic, and to have their similar "disclaimers" ready to go seems like more than just a coincidence.
